name: readBatch
description: Read many files, or byte ranges of them, in one round-trip. The JSON envelope is an index (one entry per request, echoing its path); the bytes travel as ONE concatenated buffer on a transferred binary port, because a response can carry only a single buffer.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: One entry per read: { path: string, offset?: integer, length?: integer }. Omitted or zero length means 'to end of file' from offset. Capped at 512 items per call.
